prompt: In the Splice project {project}: start a session, make the end card blue, add a marker at frame 200 named Beat, and split the screen take at frame 300. Then the director changes their mind: undo your whole session so the project is exactly as you found it. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: no marker left
checks.expr: not any(m.get('name') == 'Beat' for m in project['markers'])
